method: Exact real multilinear Möbius transform on the Boolean cube. For each gate label, evaluate its one-hot indicator on all 2^11 GateProjection states, then apply subset Möbius inversion. Interaction order is the largest subset size with nonzero coefficient.
closure_interpretation: The selected trefoil cubes are local witnesses only. Complete interaction coverage for the finite gate quotient is supplied instead by exhaustive evaluation of all 2^11 states and all subset coefficients. No one-hot gate indicator has order 11; the exact maximum is 10.
non_claim: Multilinear interaction order is representation-relative to the declared Boolean GateProjection coordinates and one-hot gate observables. It does not imply a universal causal interaction order for richer ActionIntent, authority preprocessing, natural-language extraction, or physical systems.
